role: read-only independent scorer and protocol reviewer; no producer changes
fixed_historical_panel: 2026 REG Weeks 1-7; earlier years only where explicitly supported
preexisting_exposure: 2022-2026 historical outcomes and prior reports have been examined; this is exposed development, not fresh confirmation
prohibited: editing original forecasts, producer code or shared ledgers
availability_arms: Audit A/B query and feature freshness with exact identical retained model, query identities and outcome contract; audit C separately as a changed fit/training-availability mechanism. Establish source-known time from retained source receipt, not kickoff or a presumed seven-day delay.
historical_evidence: current-vintage reconstruction with assumed historical availability remains separate from information actually retained and known at current issuance
ablation_contract: Unordered versus ordered feature-block procedures must preserve source, clock, fitting population, objective, estimator parameters, history floor and evaluation identities except the registered feature block. Report what the block removes, not a broader claim that ordering alone was isolated.
comparison_contract: Select strongest available compatible control under a frozen deterministic rule; retain its procedure/history/product and matched row hash. Native error delta=candidate-control; relative delta=delta/control with null reason when control is zero. No cross-unit pooled ranking.
future_grading: Keep original packets immutable, preserve exact T90 and owner cutoff status, source/identity hashes and actual issuance/persistence times; no future grade until qualified finality and labels are admitted through a frozen grader.
cohorts: Same frozen ranking membership and fallback/learned-only scope across competitors. Historical reconstruction cannot authenticate original issuance or a pregame selection rule.
metrics: Independently recompute supported point, proper probability/law summaries and fallback counts from retained rows; genuine chart medians and labels use exact integer .02 coordinates for precision tolerances. Means keep their distinct stored-point semantics.
support_and_failures: Retain missing labels, explicit abstentions, proper support and true infinite log losses. Software checks add no NFL samples. Failed or partial runs keep their original identity and consumed resources.
uncertainty: Paired loss differences on exact common rows; seven exposed 2026 weeks are insufficient for an eight-cluster weekly bootstrap and do not support a permanent optimality claim
outputs: Public-safe independent scripts, aggregate checks, defects and limitations under this directory only; root owns canonical score registration and publication
